metadata.title: Plan Work Item Implementation
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create a detailed implementation plan for an Azure DevOps work item by fetching its details and analyzing the codebase. Use as a standalone planning process or as a sub-process within the SDLC orchestrator.

steps.name: Fetch Work Item Details
steps.output: Work item details: title, description, acceptance criteria, detailed solution

steps.name: Analyze Codebase
steps.output: Affected files, patterns, dependencies, integration points, infra/config changes

guidance.approach: Use parallel explore subagents to investigate different areas simultaneously

planSections: Affected files table (path, change type, description)
rules: No code snippets — describe what to implement, not the implementation itself
Use business-domain names, not technical/infrastructure names
Order: dependencies/config → module wiring → feature code → infra/DevOps → tests
